summary: Comprehensive backend regression for Aura app. Created pytest suite (30 tests) covering health, weather (Open-Meteo proxy), auth (401/valid), full items CRUD with persistence verification, AI analyze-item (gpt-5.4 vision), AI stylist/suggest (validates only owned item ids appear in resolved_items), AI shop-check (verdict Buy/Skip/Maybe + required keys), outfits create/list (hydrated items), wear logging (verified wear_count increments and last_worn set), insights (all keys + types), and AI missing-piece. All 30 tests passed on preview URL. Auth negative paths (no token / bad token) return 401 as expected. Real JPEG image with visible garment features generated via PIL used for AI vision endpoints.

minor.issue: Return HTTP 200 for creation; convention is 201 Created. Not a blocker but worth noting.
Always returns 200 {ok:true} even when id does not exist (no 404). Silent no-op could mask client bugs.
Empty body correctly returns 400, but flatters/price cannot be explicitly set to false/0 through update because payload filters out None only — actually acceptable (false/0 pass); no fix needed.

action_items: Optional: Return 404 from DELETE /api/items/{id} when the item does not exist (currently silent success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 625 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, items, ai, insights) as it grows.
AI endpoints have no explicit timeout on LlmChat.send_message; a slow OpenAI call could tie up workers. Consider a wrapper timeout.
shop-check does not validate that base64 payload is non-empty before hitting the LLM; a 400 pre-check would save cost.
insights.most_worn/least_worn returns full item docs including base64 photos — response can be very large; consider trimming photo fields.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded user_testaura01 + 5 items. Tests created and then cleaned up their own TEST_ prefixed items/outfits/wear logs (residual TEST_ rows removed post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token 'test-session-token-aura-123' -> user_testaura01. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env — noteworthy if writing UI tests. AI endpoints require real clothing image (JPEG/PNG base64 with real visual features); use PIL helper in conftest.py. All AI calls average ~3-8s; use timeout=120s. Frontend was NOT tested (Emergent Google OAuth cannot be automated).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in tested surface.
